title: Reverse a Number
description:
Given `n = 12345`, reverse the number using a while loop (without converting to a string). Print the reversed number.

**Expected output:**
```
54321
```
starterCode:
n = 12345
reversed_num = 0
# Reverse n using arithmetic
# Print reversed_num
hint: Each iteration: take the last digit with n % 10, add it to reversed_num * 10, then remove the last digit with n //= 10.
